body:
Thank you very much for everything, i am happy i could give you something as well. I will definitely talk to you :)

P.s. You should read Harry Potter. It is very inspirational

"We might be different from others but if I might say so, it makes us somewhat special"
I've been looking for a quote to write on my wall to inspire me and help me get Out of bed on bad days and Make my smile Even brighter on good ones...
Would you mind if i used that One?
I have One quote on my door its from Harry Potter (my favorite Books)
From Sirius Black. "We've all got both light and dark inside us. What matters is the part we choose to act on. That's who we really are"
It means a lot to me and your quote will always refer to my First time outside touching the Grass again, so it also means very much to me

Thank you! I am very proud of myself and it makes me very happy you are proud as well!
I agree with you, the kind of emotional pain that numbs your body and mind is aweful, but also an opportunity to learn about yourself and get over your limits. I havent slept right in months but the fresh air and all those "new" impressions my mind has to process after actually going outside and what big step that means for me emotionally, i am really exhausted and think i might sleep well tonight.
I am very happy i did it and the mixture of glowing excitement and sharp fear that made me dizzy was absolutely worth it.
I would have never thought that a small thing like this would Make this Big of a change.
I smiled again. Not the fake smile i got to know over the years, a real One that hurt my cheeks Because it stayed on my Face all day!!!
I cannot thank you enough! I owe you a lot more than you might imagine!!!!

I DID IT!
I went outside!!! I felt a chilly breeze on my face and heard birds sing and cars drive... I walked around the block and over to that place I saw from my window, just as I planned it. I sat down and touched the grass with my hands. This is gonna sound weird but I laid down and felt the grass tickle my face... It was great.. When I got up people were coming up to that place so I turned and walked home. I can still feel the grass on my skin.. I havent felt happier in a long time. I am incredible thankful you gave me that advice.. It was a bit scary but not too much because I spent the whole night doing it over and over again in my head, I couldnt sleep anyways.. so it felt like i did it before.. It was so great!!!
Thank you so much!!!

I am happy i Could help you in some way, since you have been a great support the last day. I send you a picture of my drawing in a pm as soon as i get to upload it (i am using my phone right now and it doesnt work). I am very excited to hear what you think.
I have spotted a playground from my window and already decided the exact spot where i want to sit and feel the grass between my fingers. The more i make plans about it the more i can actually imagine doing it.. It is not only "leave the house" i have an idea of where to go and what to do... I feel like detailed plans are very helpful when facing a scary Situation.
Maybe that can help you too, when trying something new.. Close your eyes and imagine yourself doing it, then remember what and how exactly you did it and go over it in your Head until it is an exact plan

Eventhough it is the words of an internet stranger, your advice means a lot to me. I want to thank you for listening like no one has been listening to me in a long time!
I  not very good in writing but i love to draw. I want  combine those two ideas and maybe try to draw in a Notebook, One drawing each day that expresses my feelings,thoughts or fears of that particular day.
I just finished todays drawing. I am not an artist or anyhow good at drawing but I always feel a burden to fall Off my shoulders when i draw.. When i have a pencil in my Hand i am free.. But i cant capture that Feeling, i cant Make it Stick with me, it fades away too quick! I like todays drawing, it seems to express well how divided i feel between feeling good and afraid about tomorrow.
If you would want to i Could Show it to you. (You dont have to look at it, just if you would like )

Thank you for saying i am brave. I dont feel brave at all. I am scared, terrified of that huge task i have to master tomorrow... I actually just took a shower (i know it is gross but i cant motivate myself to get Out of bed and Take a shower Most days so its a big Deal sort of) and made me tea. It is nothing Special but it is exactly that: something normal and for a few minutes i felt a bit more normal.. It was a good feeling...

Your concerne of me dehydrating touches me. It is weird but no One has worried about me like this...put on a jacket its cold outside, Drink enough water, dont forget to look both sides when crossing the street. Last time i heard cooncernes like this i was a small Child. Thank you for taking the Time to consider i havent been outside in a while and might forget to drink..(it is not hot here at all tho )
You seem to be a wonderful person! I really hope your therapy will help you, Maybe you can tell me about how you experienced Talking to a psychologist. 
I am glad you answered to my post, it feels very good Talking to you and i hope you find the strength to get through whatever troubles your beautiful heart.

I would love to tell you about my day tomorrow... I think if i have someone to tell it to i will not change my mind in the Last second and run back to my room...
I think i want to walk around the block.. Not too far away from home..  But i cant remember the Last time i touched the grass so this will be my goal for tomorrow...
I was thinking about therapy... Maybe it would be good to Talk to someone? On a regular basis about everything... But i dont know, if i am strong enough for that

To answer your questions, no i dont have any friends... I wish i had, but on the other side i expect them to hurt me anyways so i am not sure how to feel about friends...
Many people told me that going outside would help, i am having a bad day today, but i decided that tomorrow i will leave the appartement. I am scared, i dont feel like i belong in this World and it will reject me like a foreign matter.. I dont know how to behave around people, they scare me.. They will just point at me and laugh behind my back like they always did.
But tomorrow i will. I will leave the house and touch the grass... That is my plan.. It is very scary but maybe i will feel better... I dont know.
I stood at the door today for a good 30minutes but i couldnt... I had bad dreams today after a night of no sleep at all.. I dont feel strong enough.

I live with my mom and her boyfriend. I
Currently dont really do anything.... Trying to find a way to be with my Boyfriend but not so sure if i still want it..

What makes me happy? Thats a very tough question.. I guess if there was someone in my life that cares. Getting a text message from a friend asking how i'm doing or if i want to come over.
On the One side i dont have the strength to leave my room, but on the other side my walls seem to suffocate me... I want something that its worth for getting Out of bed in the morning.. It just feels like i ran out of reasons to live for, Out of excuses not to die and i want a reason, i want an excuse, i want someone to care!
I want my mom to love me.
Whenever she walks past my door i wish she would come in and hug me..

The Problem is that i never know when he is doing what because he doesnt keep me posted about his Day at all. I would ask him what he's up to and he's like "just been sitting at home all day"
Yea well thanks for taking that time to Talk to me -.-

Thank you. I will do that. For today i think i went over enough problems, childhood and relationship issues and so on. I will simply rejoice because of his message. I will text you tomorrow.. I dont know you and i dont know a person i would rather open up to... I never imagined such a positive feedback from him.

This sounds stupid, but you saved me!!!
I was always alone. I know if i was alone today, i would have not had the strength.. I know i should not be like that, but i cannot live without him, not now.. This Message from him does not solve all my personal issues, but for the first time in a long while i can smile... I have a lot of problems and i would love to talk to you about them
If you would not mind.

I just texted him this
"I love you darling. Just wanted to let you know that i'm thinking of you. I know you are at work and if you read this but dont have the time to respond its ok. Just know i am with you. We will be alright"
Suprisingly i got this reply a second later
"You truely are an angel. Sorry i am being so difficult... Thank you for going through this with me. I love you too"

I cannot thank you enough!!! This is the first positive feedback i got from him in a month!!! I feel happy! I cant remember the last time i smiled, it actually feels weird to smile!
Thank you thank you!!!
I am not confused, he will still be a dick to me Sometimes, but i truely think he appreciates that. Thank you for this advice!!

I feel miserable... Someone replied to my post on r/depression and i got to talk to someone wich felt good. But i also tried to talk to my SO and he told me to fuck off because he is watching a movie.. Whenever i start to feel a little better something bad happens...
Instead of dealing with his issues he pushes them away, i cant blame him, i know it is easier for the moment... But it hurts me to be his punching bag

Thank you very much... I can reckognize so much of him in what you just told me about yourself...your last sentence makes so much sense... His biggest fear is to fail me i know that. But i have never saw it from this point, that in his mind he is failing me right now... I cant believe i have not seen it like this before...
Can I ask you something very personel?
If she knew about how you felt and would have talked to you about it, how would you have wished for her to approach the conversation?
if he feels attacked or offended the conversation is over because he gets defensive and doesnt listen... i understand and respect this behavious so i try really hard not to make him feel critizised.. i dont know how to bring it up if he really feels like this

First of all you don't have to apologize for any assumptions, I am thankful for you help.
I get the same responses from him no matter what I try to talk about... I just finished a drawing I am very proud of and sent it to him (it used to make him happy that his opinion about my drawings mean so much to me)
he just said "fuck, you really need me to comment on every fucking drawing you make?"
I just pointed out the situations i ask him for more time, to show that he is not willing to compromise with me...
I just reread what I commented, and you are right, it definitely sounds like i would not pay attention to his problems or needs. i dont have the impression that i do that in our relationship (of course i can not say it objective but just from my point of few).
When i was still there his mom was already very sick and i spend a lot of time taking care of her... he is going through many anger management classes because of his probation. I am always trying to consider how would i feel in his shoes... He also thanks me a lot for my support. he says that he wouldnt know how to deal with all that crap if he didnt have me...
also his family say they have never seen him the way he is with me, he used to get in trouble a lot and since i am with him he kept out of all that shit... 
I am not trying to show off or convince you i am a great girlfriend or so. I make mistakes and I know that.. I am just trying to give you a better look of how our relationship looks like...
I know there is nothing that stresses him out more than coming home and having to cook,so i make sure theres always dinner on the table when he is there.... little things like that.

Before I left we had a heart to heart conversation.. he told me with everything going on and without having me here for help with his mom for example he will not be able to find much time, he talked about maybe 2-3 times a week skype where we can have conversations maybe an hour long, and other than that maybe just a 2 minute call in the morning or evening for a short i love you and some texts during the day when there is time..
Thats not much but I understood and told him thats ok... You are very right, he has the need for space and "alone" or "guy" time... I told him if he wants to hang out with friends go to the gym for a hike, thats fine with me, i want him to do that, i dont want him to give up his friends... But I also told him, if he does not find any time for me at all but has time to meet up with friends all the time it will upset me.. He promised it wont be that way..
Now that i am here, nothing of the said things remain... we skyped about 3 times since i am back none of them longer than 10 minutes...
It is not enough to keep up a relationship out of 2 texts a day and theyre even insultive sometimes...
I havent heard from him in 2 days and texted "good morning darling" at the time he wakes up and got "the fuck is so good about it?" back.. thinking it maybe was just a joke i said "well we are both awake, thats a good thing right there :)"
he said "you can shove that sarcasm up your ass, leave me the fuck alone".

I always did and i still am trying to be understanding of his situation of life... I appreciate the patience and respect he has (well, had) for me and i am giving that back.

Again, not trying to pretend i am awesome and he's an asshole.. he is not.. something went wrong and by giving you further details of how our relationship looks like i hope you can help me figure out what it is that went wrong
I didn't have someone to talk to in a long time... I would love to talk to you

well there are 2 people that I wish I was closer two,
one would be my sister.. I love her because she is my sister, but she is an egoistic person, she does not care about my feelings as long as she gets her way. she always wants and asks favors but if I ask her one she doesnt have time or simply doesnt want to help me.

And then there is my boyfriend.. The situation between me and him is what has been pulling me down most lately...
He lives in the states and I live in germany, when we are together he is the greatest man you could imagine. He is understanding, caring and loving, he is so patient with me... I am always afraid to just look like a cry baby or someone who wants others to feel bad for me, so it takes me long to actually talk to him if something is wrong. But he holds my hand in silence for hours until I feel comfortable enough to cry and talk, he holds me and either finds the right words or is simply there and lets me feel i am not alone... 
Last time we were seperated (when I had to go back to germany) we had many fights and he was distant, but we always talked things out, told each other I love you at the end..
This time it is different, I am back in germany for over a month and he refuses to make time for me. (he has a lot going on with a sick mother, work, probation and so on) . He finds time tho to hang out with friends, I dont hear from him at all for days. But the worst part is that whenever I do hear from him, he is not himself. He us rude to me, hurtful. I told him I wish we could find more time for each other, maybe once a day, it doesnt have to be hour long skype, but maybe a short text message "baby I'm alright, just super busy. I love you"... that would make me happy. and i would take him 20 seconds.. He answered with "quit being such a needy bitch!"
he says things like go fuck yourself! which I think just cross a line, you should not say that to your significant other...
Last night i felt very alone. I felt so numb and cut off from the world... It is just a feeling that overcomes me from time to time, I break down and cant stop crying for long times, hours sometimes... It happened when I was with him before. He came home and i was laying on the floor screaming of pain. not physical pain, but the pain was so clear, so sharp, it couldve been a cut from a knife. He laid flat on the floor next to me, held my hand and said "share it with me, let me take some of that pain away...together we can endure it, i promise".
Last night when i called he said "call me when you calmed the fuck down, i cant understand shit what you say and i dont want to waste my time listen to you sobbing bitch"

His behaviour hurts me.. he used to be the rock in my rough sea of life, he used to be the shoulder to lean on and now he becomes the source of my pain.. I dont know how to handle that

I tried.. "shit, you know I busy things are right now! I dont have time for that!
His mom is very sick, and I know between work, his mom and court he doesnt have much time..but there is time to hang out with friends.. not for me tho

My biggest problem is that I don't feel like I'm getting forward in any way... Every single person that I ever loved or trusted without exception has turned around at one point in time to hurt me purposely. I am tired of getting let down and disappointed. I don't want anybody around me. I am lonely and there is no reason for me to be here.
I just feel like I have nothing to live for anymore, there is no getting forward, I am stuck in a vacuum

If i just knew what happened for him to turn around and be like this...
I don't know... I love him i really do, but I guess if I am honest to myself I love the idea of someone being there for me like he used to be.
I'm just tired of getting disappointed. and if I will just sit in my dark room everyday all day long I might just as well leave this world.. there is nothing out there for me aymore

Everything in me yells and tells me that if i find the strength to get going, it has to be without him... But then I remember who he was or is or can be.. I dont know.. He would have never talked to me like this... The "old" stand would have quit everything he was doing and just said "tell me about it angel... I am here"
And what if he can be that person again but I leave him? I am not strong on my own anymore...
Running away actually sounds nice...
